verified_on_cpu: TorchScript preserves parameter identities, checkpoint keys, logits/values and gradients
Adam moments and step values preserved across load/normalization
KL rejection leaves weights and optimizer state unchanged
Nonfinite gradient rejection occurs before optimizer update

Every-step timeout bootstrapping, TorchScript export, headless watch and report

cuda_design.optimizer_preflight: Disposable scalar probe chooses fused or foreach before real updates.
cuda_design.model_execution: Actual-device eager/script forward+backward probes choose script only above a 5% measured gain and after parity checks.
cuda_design.memory_budget: Probe peak plus resident-rollout allowance within 85% of currently allocatable GPU memory.
cuda_design.existing_run: No saved config, architecture, reward, timing, epochs or minibatch changes for ordinary resume.
cuda_design.batch_experiment: New fork has larger minibatch only if selected; optimizer-update frequency changes and strength must be evaluated.
